verdict.rationale: AI Gateway logs per-request cost, token usage, and provider for every model call (docs-2, docs-34), consolidates billing across all providers into one bill (docs-26, docs-40), and supports assigning budget/rate limits per user/project/team via Dynamic Routing (docs-13, docs-37). This covers spend tracking by model, provider, and team/user segmentation, but there is no explicit evidence of a dashboard view that aggregates/filters historical spend specifically 'per API key' or a dedicated cost-by-team/user reporting UI beyond routing-time quota enforcement. missing for 10: explicit per-key spend breakdown, dedicated cross-provider spend-by-team/user analytics dashboard (vs. just quota enforcement), independent/hands-on confirmation.
